thread:
Maya K: Heads-up — we need to intake and freeze capacity for a quick bring-up in eu-south1. Goal: 8x A10G-equivalent GPUs for a 48h bootstrap + validation window. Please advise on quota path and temp hold process.
Samir R: Thanks Maya. Can you share the target start window? I need to check existing reservations and any conflicting commitments.
Maya K: Target start is next Tue 09:00 UTC (48h window). We want the pool isolated for bootstrapping only (no prod traffic).
Samir R: OK. Earliest I can get ops to file for a quota increase + a temporary reservation is tomorrow morning. If we do a reservation, it'll be a soft hold with tags. Need a ticket with expected capacity, durations, and business justification.
Maya K: Opening ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-2345 — summary: "eu-south1 bootstrap pool: 8x A10G eq, 48h temp hold, network staging". Priya, Jordan — what exact perf slots do you need for validation?
Priya S: For our smoke runs we need 4 nodes with 40GB memory each (single-node tests) and 2 nodes for multi-GPU end-to-end model tests. Pack sizes: small-batch inference + a 1k-token regen. Expect ~6k tokens total over the window.
Jordan L: Networking note: eu-south1 has a VPC peering limit in our account until we add a shared subnet. We'll need a preflight: ensure route tables and firewall rules allow internal CI runners to reach the new nodes on 10.10.0.0/16. Also we should stand up a temporary NAT for outbound telemetry.
Samir R: Filing the quota request — posting required payload below. Ops, please confirm and then I’ll submit to cloud provider.
Samir R: ```json
{
  "project": "redwood-infra-staging",
  "region": "eu-south1",
  "resource": "A10G_equiv",
  "quantity": 8,
  "duration_hours": 48,
  "justification": "Bootstrap new cluster for bring-up and validation; isolated, non-prod window; model and networking smoke tests"
}
```
Maya K: @capacity-bot can you create a temporary reservation tag and hold the pool when the provider grants the quota? We want auto-release at end of window.
capacity-bot: Reservation ticket created: RES-9921. Soft hold applied on request; will attempt auto-attach when quota is active. Notifications will go to #eng-infra and the ticket.
Samir R: Submitted quota increase request to provider (ticket CP-55678). Provider ETA ~18-36h. I also asked for express review citing bootstrap window.
Jordan L: I'll prep the route/fwrules playbook. Short checklist to validate post-attach:
- Ensure SSH bastion keys are provisioned
- Update route table for 10.10.0.0/16 -> eu-south1-subnet-A
- Verify firewall: allow 22, 443, 2022 (ci runner), and internal k8s ports
- Confirm NAT gateway for telemetry egress
Maya K: Great. If provider approves early we might start Monday. Samir, can you add a manual step in the ticket to notify us before attach? Want final signoff from infra and platform.
Samir R: Will do — added checklist item: "Notify #eng-infra and add comment for manual attach". Also left a note to tag nodes with `bootstrap:eu-south1-temp` and `owner:eng-infra`.
Priya S: Once nodes are attached, I'll run the baseline eval set (quick-run) and post results here. If perf looks off we fallback to smaller batch sizes; we need logs shipped to s3://redwood-qa-logs/eu-south1/
Maya K: Thanks team. After the 48h window ends capacity-bot — please trigger teardown and confirm IP cleanup. :thumbsup:
capacity-bot: Will auto-release at 2026-03-21T09:00:00Z (48h after attach) unless a manual extend is requested on the ticket.
